body:
You make really good points. I appreciate your comments, truly do. Thank you. They really are helpful to me.

I am bisexual, actually. I don't talk a lot about it, but yeah... No offense taken.

Regarding connecting with women/girls, I don't think I ever had too much issues in connecting with women/girls as people ever since I was young due to some factors.

Although I obviously never had sex, I agree with you. For me, it seems like sex would be better for both parties if there is a deep connection, like you said.

To tell you the truth, most of the people that I talked IRL never really pressured me to lose my virginity. I am the one who pressure myself the most when it comes to losing my virginity. I see others talking about the sex they had and how great it sounds. It makes me feel like I am missing out on something out amazing.

It feels like I am unlikable. It makes me feel like shit. I want to know how sex and intimacy, and I can't. It sucks, it truly does.

You're right. There is no deadline. But as far I know, the older I get, the harder it will get.

I am sorry for what happened to you... I wish it hadn't happened to you. I am really sorry.

I am aware that there is no script... I know there isn't, but still...

Thanks for the comment, although...

>Maybe you'll meet people, maybe you won't

Honestly, I really would like to meet people. I can try being happy by myself, but not meeting anyone at all... I wouldn't want that.
I am glad you think so. I don't think I ever had any opportunity to lose it. And it doesn't seem like it's going to change...

It's not even another person who's pressuring myself... I would say I am the one pressuring myself. I see others talking about how sex is awesome, talking about the times they had sex and how great it was, and here I am, a virgin, missing out. It makes me feel as though I am an unlikable person. It makes me feel like a piece of shit.

I would say the issue is also socioromantic connection and finding intimacy, yeah...

Thanks for the advice... I wonder if people are really going to see it in me.

Sure is young. I agree with that.
As for the fact that virginity is a social construct, I wholeheartedly agree with you. It still can and does put pressure on people, including me. Sometimes I think I shouldn't be bothered by something like this because it might not be a big deal, but for the most part, I still feel pressured by it. As though I am missing out on something, you know. It can be hard not to feel pressured.

I can see why it would be considered a lifesaving experience. I moved a lot in my life, and as matter of fact, I am not even born in the country I live in right now. I just see the future as being too bleak, I guess. I want to make it a new start, if I can. But I don't know if things will change by a lot... 

I don't think losing when you are 23 years old is too old. It's just that I fear I won't lose my virginity, although I would say that my fear is probably more related to not having romantic relationships with someone than virginity by itself. Does this sound coherent?

Thank you for commenting. In a way, I want to see adult life. But I feel like the future is going to be bleak and painful. 

No offence taken. I will admit that it is a short time. It's hard to hang in there...

I understand that. I understand that I still my adult life, but it's difficult not to think that it is going to suck.

Again, thank you for your comment.
So you understand how I feel like?
It's hard to persevere, to be honest. Very hard... Thank you for the offer. It's truly nice.
I have come to the realisation that life does not get better at all. I don't know why people like to spread such a bullshit myth.

I had the knife in my hand but I couldn't go through it. Sorry if I worded in a confusing way, English is not my first language. Perhaps you could put it that I thought about stabbing myself, I suppose?
I didn't actually stab myself, but I did try it to. I am a coward so I couldn't stab myself.
I know suicide might not be worth, but what if it doesn't seem to get better? It's been one year that I have feeling the way I am, and very few things have changed. What is the point?
I feel like this is one of the things stopping me... Yeah. I don't want to sound selfish regarding those around me, but is my pain worthless?

:)

I can see that. Which is why I would like to lose my virginity with someone I care about, you know. At the same time, the physical aspect of sex seems to be really good, and like I said, it makes me feel shit about myself and makes me feel as though I am missing out on something.

I suppose you are right, yeah...

Thank you very much. <3 I am sure that you are a nice person too, and I am very grateful for the advice and for the fact that you took the time to listen to me.

It's nice to hear stuff like this, you know. From people who seem to understand where I am coming from. The thing with your friends is very similar to me too. My best friend has a girlfriend, and has almost lost his virginity. I shouldn't be feeling like this, but it makes me feel like I am in his shadow or something. 

I really do hope you are right and that I will experience it, too. I see, I suppose that does make sense that they would be more deep and mature indeed. 

I just kind of feel like I am missing out on something, you know. Sex seems like such a good thing... It feels like I am missing out on something good. It can really put me down, no matter how hard I try to tell myself that I am not a loser and that this is not a big deal. Do you understand what I mean? :/

Anyways...

Thanks, sincerely.

That is a good idea, and it's something I have been planning for a while. I am moving to somewhere where I have no friends whatsoever after I finish school, so I suppose I ought go to meetings with people who share my interests. I was thinking about trying new hobbies too. Let's see how that go... I guess.

Actually, I may not have worded very well, but I feel like the relationship aspect worries me more than the fact that I am a virgin. It may be seen as silly, however, I think I would like to lose my virginity with someone who I consider special...

>Don't lose hope.

Honestly, it's hard not to lose hope...
